crossRefs.note: So it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the children of the east came up against them.
You will sow, but won’t reap. You will tread the olives, but won’t anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but…
for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you…

translations.web: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’
translations.bsb: For in this case the saying ‘One sows and another reaps’ is true.
translations.kjv: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
translations.asv: For herein is the saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
